आ: आ The second letter of the alphabet, corresponding to A long, as in far, and written in the Roman character Ā.

आ ind. 	 1. A particle of reminiscence, (ah! oh!) 	 2. A conjunction disjunctive, (but) 	 3. A particle of compassion, (ah! alas!) 	 4. A conjunction copulative, (and.) This particle remains unaltered in orthography even before vowels.

आ or आङ् A particle, and prefix to words, implying; 1. Diminu-tion, (a little.) 	 2. Limit inceptive, (from, from thence, or that time.) 	 3. Limit conclusive, (until, unto, as far as.) 	 4. Prefixed to verbs it extends or reverses their meaning, as रुह to rise, आरुह to ascend, to mount, and गम to go, आगम to come. 	 5. In composi-tion with nouns it forms indeclinables, either crude, as आजानु to the knee, or with the terminations of the objective or ablative case, as आसमुद्रं or आसमुद्रात् as far as to the ocean. 	 6. A particle of menace or of pain, (ah! alas!) this is more correctly written आस्  E. आप् to pervade, to obtain, and डाङ् affix, प is dropped.
आ m. (आः) A name of MAHĀDEVA.
आ ind. A particle of assent, yes, verily.  E. अम to go, क्विप् affix, अ be-comes आ

आक्षेपक: आक्षेपक m. (-कः) 	 1. Sickness, disease. 	 2. Convulsion, spasm. 	 3. A de-tractor, a calumniator or accuser. 	 4. A thrower.  E. आङ् before क्षिप् to toss, ण्वुल् aff.
आक्षैत्रज्ञ: आक्षैत्रज्ञ n. (-ज्ञं) Spiritual ignorance.  E. अ neg. क्षेत्रज्ञ wise, and ष्यञ् affix, the initial optionally long.
आक्षोट: आक्षोट m. (-टः) A tree, (see पीलु,) growing in mountains: in Hindi, the corresponding name implies the walnut: see अक्षोट and आक्षोड.
आक्षोड: आक्षोड m. (-डः) A kind of Pilu, a tree so named, (Careya arborea:) see अक्षोड, अक्षोट and पीलु.
आक्षोद: आक्षोद m. (-दः) A Brahman of the Rikshoda mountain.  E. ऋक्षोद and अण् aff.
आख: आख m. (-खः) A spade, a hoe.  E. आङ्, खन् to dig, ड aff.
आखण्डल: आखण्डल m. (-लः) A name of INDRA.  E. आङ् and खण्ड to break, अलच् affix; mountain-breaking, foe-destroying.
आखन: आखन m. (-नः) 	 1. A spade. 	 2. A digger.  E. आङ्, खन् to dig, घ aff.
आखनिक: आखनिक m. (-कः) 	 1. A thief. 	 2. A rat. 	 3. A hog. 	 4. A spade. 	 5. A digger, a ditcher, a miner.  E. आङ्, खन् to dig, and इकन् Unādi aff.
आखनिकवक: आखनिकवक m. (-कः) 	 1. A spade. 	 2. A digger.  E. आङ् before खन् to dig, इकवक aff.
आखर: आखर m. (-रः) 	 1. A spade. 	 2. A digger.  E. आङ्, खन् to dig, डर aff.
आखात: आखात mn. (-तः-तं) A natural pond: see अखात.
आखान: आखान m. (-नः) 	 1. A spade. 	 2. A digger.  E. आङ्, खन् to dig. घञ् aff.
आखु: आखु m. (-खुः) 	 1. A rat, a mouse. 	 2. A hog. 	 3. A thief. 	 4. A sort of tree: see देवताड.  E. आङ्, खन् to dig, and कु Unādi aff.
आखुकर्णी: आखुकर्णी f. (-र्णी) The name of a plant, (Salvinia cucullata.)  E. आखु a mouse, and कर्ण an ear; the leaves are compared to the ears of a mouse.
आखुग: आखुग m. (-गः) 	 1. A name of GANESA. 	 2. A name of KĀRTIKEYA. E. आखु a rat, and ग who goes; GANESA is represented riding on a rat.
आखुघात: आखुघात m. (-तः) A Sudra or man of low caste and profession, lit. a rat-catcher.  E. आखु and घात a blow.
आखुपर्णिका: आखुपर्णिका f. (-का) A plant: see आखुकर्णी.  E. आखु and पर्ण a leaf.
आखुपाषाण: आखुपाषाण m. (-णः) A kind of mineral, a loadstone.  E. आखु and पाषाण a stone.
आखुभुज्: आखुभुज् m. (-भुक्) A cat.  E. आखु and भुज् who eats.
आखुरथ: आखुरथ m. (-थः) A name of GANESA.  E. आखु, and रथ a carriage; whose vehicle is a rat.
आखुविषहा: आखुविषहा f. (-हा) A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratum.)  E. आखु, विष venom, and हा what destroys; considered as a remedy for the bite of a rat.
आखूत्थ: आखूत्थ m. (-त्थः) The rising up or coming of rats, a swarm of rats. E. आखु and उत्थ from उत् and स्था with क aff.
आखेट: आखेट m. (-टः) 	 1. Chase, hunting. 	 2. Terror, fright.  E. आङ्, खिट to alarm, घञ् aff.
आखेटक: आखेटक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Hunting, a hunter. 	 2. Frightening, fright-ful. 	 n. (-कं) Hunting.  E. आखेट and कन् pleonastic affix; or आङ् with खिट and ण्वुल् aff.
आखेटशीर्षक: आखेटशीर्षक n. (-कं) A cavern, a mine.  E. आखेट terrifying, and शीर्ष the head or principal, क affix: very gloomy and terrifying.
आखेटिक: आखेटिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Who or what hunts. 	 2. Terrible, frightful. m. (-कः) 	 1. A hound. 	 2. A hunter.  E. आखेट chase, and ठक् aff.
आखोट: आखोट m. (-टः) The walnut tree. E. See अक्षोट. &c.
आख्या: आख्या f. (-ख्या) A name or appellation.  E. ख्या to say, आङ् prefixed, अङ् and टाप् fem. affs.
आख्यात: आख्यात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Said, spoken. 	 2. Called, declared. 	 3. Made known. 	 4. Inflected, declined, conjugated. E. part. past of आख्या to say, to speak, &c.
आख्यान: आख्यान n. (-नं) 	 1. A tale, a legend. 	 2. Saying, declaring.  E. आङ् before ख्या to tell, affix ल्युट्.
आख्यायक: आख्यायक m. (-कः) A messenger, a teller, an announcer or relater. 	 f. (-यिका) A tale, a true or probable story.  E. आख्या to say, खुल् affix, य inserted.
आख्येय: आख्येय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fit or proper to be said.  E. आङ् before ख्या to say, affix यत्; also आख्यातव्य.
आगत: आगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Arrived, come. 	 2. Received, obtained. 	 3. Living or residing in.  E. आङ् before गम् to go, क्त aff.
आगत्य: आगत्य ind. Having arrived.  E. आङ् before गम् to go, ल्यप् aff.
आगन्तव्य: आगन्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) What will come, what is likely to arrive. E. आङ् and गम् to go, तव्य aff.
आगन्तु: आगन्तु mfn. (-न्तुः-न्तुः-न्तु) 	 1. Coming, arriving. 	 2. Incidental, adventi-tious. 	 m. (-न्तुः) 	 1. A guest. 	 2. A stranger, a new comer. 	 3. An accident, any accidental hurt or wound.  E. आङ् before गम् to go, to come, तु affix; म becomes न; also आगान्तु and आगन्तुक.
आगन्तुक: आगन्तुक mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं) 	 1. Incidental, adventitious. (as pleasure, pain, ornament, &c.) 	 2. Stray. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. A stranger, a new comer. 2. A guest.  E. आगन्तु and कन् affix, what comes and goes: what is not inseparably inherent.
आगम: आगम m. (-मः) 	 1. Arrival, coming, approach. 	 2. A Sastra or work on sacred science in general, supposed to be of divine origin. 	 3. A Tantra or any work inculcating the mystical worship of SIVA and SAKTI. 	 4. A grammatical augment, a syllable or letter inserted in any part of the radical word. 	 5. Record, title deed, legal title, a voucher or written testimony, &c.  E. आङ् before गम् to go, to come, अच् aff.
आगमन: आगमन n. (-नं) Arriving, coming.  E. आङ् before गम् to go, ल्युट् aff.
आगमनिरपेक्ष: आगमनिरपेक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Independent of a written voucher or title. E. आगम and निरपेक्षा disregard.
आगमय्य: आगमय्य ind. Having explored or discovered.  E. आङ् before गम् to go, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
आगमरहित: आगमरहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Devoid of a written title or voucher. 	 2. Without a Sastra.  E. आगम and रहित devoid of.
आगमसापेक्ष: आगमसापेक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) With or supported by legal vouchers. E. आगम and सापेक्ष regard to.
आगमापायिन्: आगमापायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Transient, of short duration.  E. आगम and अपायिन् separating, going at the time of arrival.
आगमित: आगमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Read over, perused, studied.  E. आङ् prefixed to गम् in the causal form; participial affix क्त.
आगम्य: आगम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) 	 1. To be approached, accessible. 	 2. To be acquired. E. आङ् before गम् with यत् aff.
आगस्: आगस् n. (-गः) 	 1. Sin. 	 2. Transgression, offence, fault.  E. आग substituted for इण् to go, असुन् Unādi aff.
आगाध: आगाध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Very deep: see अगाध.
आगान्तु: आगान्तु mfn. (-न्तुः-न्तुः-न्तु) A guest: see आगन्तु.
आगामिन्: आगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) 	 1. Arriving, coming. 	 2. Future.  E. आङ् before गम् to go, णिनि aff.
आगार: आगार n. (-रं) A house, a dwelling: see अगार.
आगारदाह: आगारदाह m. (-हः) Arson, setting a house on fire.  E. आगार and दाह burn-ing.
आगारदाहिन्: आगारदाहिन् m. (-ही) An incendiary.  E. आगारदाह arson, and इनि aff.
आगुर्: आगुर् f. (-गूः) An agreement: see आगू.
आगुरव: आगुरव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) 	 1. Consisting of or containing Agallochum. 	 2. Very heavy.  E. अगुरु and अण् aff.
आगू: आगू f. (-गूः) An agreement.  E. आगम to come, डू affix or आङ् prefixed to गू to come and क्विन् affix; also आगुर्.
आग्रीध्र: आग्रीध्र n. (-ध्रं) The place where a sacrificial fire is kindled.  E. अग्नि fire, and इन्ध to kindle; see अग्नीध्र.
आग्नेय: आग्नेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Belonging or relating to fire or its deity. 	 n. (-यं) 1. The name of a city, (Devikotta, on the Coromandel Coast.) 	 2. Blood. 	 3. Ghee or boiled butter. 	 m. (-यः) A mane of the saint AGASTI. 	 f. (-यी) 	 1. The wife of AGNI. 	 2. The south-east quarter, of which AGNI is the regent.  E. अग्नि fire or its deity, ढक् affix which leaves एय.
आग्रह: आग्रह m. (-हः) 	 1. Favour, patronage. 	 2. Seizing, taking. 	 3. Surpassing, surmounting. 	 4. Power, ability.  E. आङ्, ग्रह to take, अप् aff.
आग्रहायण: आग्रहायण m. (-णः) A month so called, the first of the Hindu year ac-cording to some systems, (November-December.)  E. अग्र beginning, and हायन a year; also अग्रहायण, the अ being unchanged.
आग्रहायणिक: आग्रहायणिक m. (-कः) The month Āgrahayana.  E. अग्रहायण and ठक् aff.
आग्रहायणी: आग्रहायणी f. (-णी) 	 1. The name of a constellation consisting of three stars, one of which is Orionis, figured by an antelope's head, hence also मृगशिरस्. 	 2. The day of full moon in the month Āgrahayana.  E. अग्रहायण and ङीप् aff.
आग्रायण: आग्रायण n. (-णं) A sacrifice offered when the new rice or wheat ripens. E. अग्र chief, अयन coming, अण् aff.
आग्रायणेष्टि: आग्रायणेष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A particular ceremony: see the last.  E. आग्रायण and इष्टि a sacrifice.
आघट्टक: आघट्टक m. (-कः) 	 1. A tree, (the red sort of Achyranthes.) 	 2. A rubber, what effects friction.  E. आङ् before घट्ट to move, and वुन् aff.
आघट्टन: आघट्टन n. (-नं) 	 1. Friction, rubbing, contact. 	 2. Shaking.  E. आङ् before घट्ट to move, ल्युट् aff.
आघट्टित: आघट्टित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Touched, rubbed. 	 2. Shaken.  E. आङ् before घट्ट to move, affix क्त.
आघर्ष: आघर्ष m. (-र्षः) Rubbing, friction.  E. आङ् before घृष् to rub, affix घञ्.
आघर्षण: आघर्षण n. (-णं) Rubbing, friction. 	 f. (-णी) A brush, a rubber.  E. आङ् before घृष् to rub, affix ल्युट्.
आघर्षित: आघर्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Rubbed.  E. आङ् before घृष् to rub, क्त aff.
आघाट: आघाट m. (-टः) 	 1. A limit, a boundary. 	 2. A tree, (Achyranthes aspera.) E. आङ्, घट to endeavour, घञ् aff.
आघात: आघात m. (-तः) 	 1. Killing, striking. 	 2. A blow, a wound. 	 3. A slaughter-house, a place for killing animals or victims.  E. आङ्, हन to kill or injure, in the participial form; घ is substituted for ह.
आघातन: आघातन n. (-नं) 	 1. Striking, killing. 	 2. A slaughter-house.  E. आङ्, हन to kill or injure, ल्युट् aff.
आघार: आघार m. (-रः) 	 1. Ghee or boiled butter. 	 2. Sprinkling. 	 3. Sprinkling ghee at certain sacrifices.  E. आङ्, घृ to sprinkle, घञ् aff.
आघूर्णन: आघूर्णन n. (-नं) 	 1. Rolling, tossing. 	 2. Whirling.  E. आङ् before घूर्ण to roll, affix ल्युट्.
आघूर्णित: आघूर्णित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Rolled, rolling. 	 2. Whirled round.  E. आङ् before घूर्ण to roll, affix क्त.
आघोषण: आघोषण n. (-णं) A crying or proclaiming.  E. आङ् before घुष to sound, affix ल्युट्.
आघ्नत्: आघ्नत् mfn. (-घ्नन्-घ्नती-घ्नत्) Striking, beating.  E. आङ् before हन् to kill, affix शतृ.
आघ्राण: आघ्राण m. (-णः) 	 1. Smelling. 	 2. Satisfaction, satiety.  E. आङ्, घ्रा to smell, युट् aff.
आघ्रात: आघ्रात mfn. (-ताः-ता-तं) 	 1. Smelled, scented. 	 2. Surmounted, surpassed. 	 3. Satisfied, satiated.  E. क्त participial affix after आघ्रा to smell, &c.
आङ्क्षी: आङ्क्षी f. (-ङ्क्षी) A musical instrument, a tabor.
आङ्ग: आङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) 	 1. Bodily, corporeal. 	 2. Having limbs or parts, or relating to them. 	 3. Relating to the inferior persons of a drama, to a portion of the Vedas, &c.: see अङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A soft delicate form or body.  E. अङ्ग a body, अण् aff.
आङ्गक: आङ्गक m. (-कः) 	 1. The ruler of the country Anga. 	 2. An inhabitant of the same.  E. अङ्ग and वुञ् aff.
आङ्गार: आङ्गार n. (-रं) A multitude of firebrands.  E. आङ्गार a torch, अण् aff.
आङ्गिक: आङ्गिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Bodily, corporeal. 	 2. Gesticulated, expressed by bodily action, (dramatic sentiment, passion, &c. exhibited by attitude, gesture, &c.) 	 m. (-कः) A player on a tabor or drum. E. अङ्ग the body, ठञ् aff.
आङ्गिरस: आङ्गिरस m. (-सः) A name of VRIHAPATI, preceptor of the gods. E. अङ्गिरस् a saint so named, patronymic affix अण्; ANGIRAS being the father of VRIHASPATI.
आङ्गुलिक: आङ्गुलिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Like a finger.  E. अङ्गुली and ठक् aff.
आचक्षमाण: आचक्षमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Saying, declaring.  E. आङ् before चक्ष to speak, शानच् aff.
आचक्षुस्: आचक्षुस् m. (-क्षुः) A learned man, a Pandit.  E. आङ् before चक्ष् to speak, उसि Unādi aff.
आचतुर्य: आचतुर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Clumsiness, stupidity.  E. अचतुर and यञ् aff.
आचतुर्य्य: आचतुर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Clumsiness, stupidity.  E. अचतुर and यञ् aff.
आचम: आचम m. (-मः) Rincing the mouth: see the next.
आचमन: आचमन n. (-नं) 	 1. Rincing the mouth, sipping water before religious ceremonies, meals, &c. from the palm of the hand, and spitting it out again; the ceremony also includes touching the body in various parts. 	 2. Gargling the throat, &c.  E. आङ् before चम् to eat, ल्युट् aff.
आचमनक: आचमनक m. (-कः) A spitting pot.  E. आचमन, वुन् aff.
आचमनीय: आचमनीय n. (-यं) 	 1. Water for rincing the mouth. 	 2. A gargle.  E. आङ् before चम् to eat, affix अनीयर्.
आचम्य: आचम्य ind. Having rinsed the mouth, having sipped and rejected a lit-tle water.  E. आङ् before चम् to eat, ल्यप् aff.
आचरण: आचरण n. (-णं) 	 1. Following, observing, usage, practice. 	 2. An insti-tuted rite or rule of conduct.  E. आङ् before चर् to go, ल्युट् aff.
आचरणीय: आचरणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Right, proper, what is to be followed or ob-served.  E. आङ् before चर to go, अनीयर् aff.
आचरत्: आचरत् mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्) Following, practising, observing.  E. आङ् before चर् to go, शतृ aff.
आचरित: आचरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Observed, practised, either as a rite or usage. 2. Usual, customary. 	 3. Enjoined, fixed by rule.  E. आङ् before चर to go, affix क्त.
आचर्य: आचर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be gone to or approached.  E. आङ् before चर् to go, यत् aff.
आचर्य्य: आचर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) To be gone to or approached.  E. आङ् before चर् to go, यत् aff.
आचान्त: आचान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 	 1. Sipped and ejected, (as water.) 	 2. One who has rinsed his mouth, &c.  E. आङ् before चम् to eat, affix क्त.
आचाम: आचाम m. (-मः) Sipping water, rincing the mouth.  E. आङ् before चम् to eat, affix. घञ्.
आचाम्य: आचाम्य n. (-म्यं) 	 1. Rincing the mouth, &c. 	 2. Water so used. 	 3. A gar-gle.  E. आङ् before चम् to eat, ण्यत् aff.
आचार: आचार m. (-रः) 	 1. An established rule of conduct, an ordinance, an in-stitute, a precept. 	 2. Custom, practice, usage.  E. आङ् before चर् to go, घञ् aff.
आचारवर्जित: आचारवर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Irregular, out or rule. 	 2. Outcaste. E. आचार an institute, and वर्ज्जित abandoned.

आदृत: आदृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Respectful. 	 2. Respected, honoured, worship-ped. 	 3. Zealous, diligent.  E. आङ् before दृञ् to have, and क्त aff.

आधूर्य्य: आधूर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Weakness, infirmity.  E. अ neg. धूर्य्य to be borne, अण् aff.
आधृत: आधृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Contained, supported.  E. आङ् before धृ to have, क्त aff.
आधेय: आधेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. Placed, deposited or to be deposited. 	 2. To be received or supported. 	 3. To be pledged or mortgaged.  E. आङ् be-fore धा to have or hold, and यत् aff.
आधोरण: आधोरण m. (-णः) The rider or driver of an elephant.  E. आङ् before धोर to move well, ल्युट् aff.
आध्मात: आध्मात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Sounded, sounding. 	 2. Inflated. 	 3. Burnt. 	 m. (-तः) 	 1. Flatulence, borborygmi, swelling of the abdomen with noise. 	 2. War, battle.  E. आङ् before ध्मा to blow, affix क्त.
आध्मान: आध्मान n. (-नं) 	 1. Blowing, inflation. 	 2. A bellow. 	 3. Intumescence, swelling of the belly, dropsy.  E. आङ् before ध्मा to blow, and ल्युट aff.
आध्या: आध्या f. (-ध्या) Recollection, remembering especially with regret.  E. आङ् before ध्यै to reflect, अच् affix, and टाप् fem.
आध्यात्मिक: आध्यात्मिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to the supreme spirit, spiritual, holly.  E. अध्यात्म the soul, and ठक् aff.

आसाव्य: आसाव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be born.  E. षु to bear, affix ण्यत्.
आसिक: आसिक m. (-कः) A swordsman.  E. असि a sword, and ठक् aff.
आसिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) One who sits.  E. आस् to sit, ण्वुल् aff.
आसिक्त: आसिक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Sprinkled.  E. आङ् before षिच् to sprinkle, क्त aff.
आसित: आसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Sat down. 	 2. Who sits or is seated. 	 n. (-तं) 1. Place of abode, a city. 	 2. A seat.  E. आस् to sit, क्त aff.
आसिद्ध: आसिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 	 1. Accomplished, effected. 	 2. Put under restraint: see आसेध.  E. आङ् before षिध् to go, &c. affix क्त.
आसीन: आसीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sitting, seated.  E. आस् to sit, शानच् affix, form irr.
आसीनप्रचलायित: आसीनप्रचलायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Nodding, rocking as seated, falling asleep. E. आसीन and प्रचलायित set in motion.
आसुति: आसुति m. (-तिः) Distilling, distillation.  E. आङ before षूञ. to produce, affix क्तिन्.
आसुतीबल: आसुतीबल m. (-लः) 	 1. A sacrificer at the full and change of the moon. 2. A distiller.  E. आसुति and बलच् aff.
आसुर: आसुर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Infernal, demoniac, belonging or relating to the Asuras. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. An Asur or demon. 	 2. A form of marriage, in which the bridegroom gives to the bride, her father and paternal kinsmen, as much as he can afford. 	 n. (-रं) Black salt. 	 f. (-री) 	 1. A division of medicine, surgery, curing by cutting with instruments, applying the actual cautery, &c. 	 2. Mustard.  E. असुर a demon, अण् aff. and in the fem. ङीप्.
आसेक: आसेक m. (-कः) Sprinkling.  E. आङ् before षिच् to sprinkle, affix घञ्.
आसेचन: आसेचन n. (-नं) Sprinkling. 	 mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Beloved, desired.  E. आङ् before षिच् to sprinkle, ल्युट् affix; also असेचनक.
आसेचनक: आसेचनक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) See the preceding.  E. आङ् before षिच् to sprinkle, ल्युट् and कन् affs. also असेचनक.
आसेद्धृ: आसेद्धृ m. (-द्धा) One who confines or arrests another.  E. आङ् before षिध् to go, and तृच् aff.
आसेध: आसेध m. (-धः) Arrest, legal restraint of four kinds; कालासेधः limit of time, स्थानासेधः confinement to a place, प्रवासासेधः prohibition against removal or departure, कर्म्मासेधः restriction from employment. E. आङ् before षिध् to go, घञ् aff.
आसेध्य: आसेध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) To be interrupted, prohibited or restrained. E. आङ् before षिध् to go, यत् aff.
आस्कन्दन: आस्कन्दन n. (-नं) 	 1. Going, going to, approaching. 	 2. Effacing, de-stroying. 	 3. Reproach, abuse. 	 4. War, battle. 	 5. Drying.  E. आङ् before स्कन्द to go, ल्युट् aff.
आस्कन्दित: आस्कन्दित n. (-तं) The walk of a horse.  E. आङ् before स्कन्द to go, क्त aff.
आस्तर: आस्तर m. (-रः) 	 1. A covering, a coverlet, a blanket thrown over the back of a horse or elephant. 	 2. Spreading clothes, &c. 	 3. A car-pet, a bed.  E. आङ् before स्तृञ् to spread, and अप् aff.
आस्तरण: आस्तरण n. (-णं) 	 1. A carpet, a rug, a quilt, bed-clothes. 	 2. A bed. 	 3. A layer of sacred grass spread out at a sacrifice. 	 4. An elephant's housings, a painted cloth or blanket worn on his back. E. As the preceding, affix ल्युट्.
आस्तिक: आस्तिक m. (-कः) The name of a Muni or saint.  E. अस्ति who is and वुञ् affix; from an expression of his father, (he is in the womb,) pro-nouncing his conception to have taken place before there were any external indications of it. 	 mfn. (-कः-की-कं) A believer, pious, faith-ful.  E. अस्ति as before, saying that there is a God, &c. in opposition to the नास्तिक an atheist, and ठक् aff.
आस्तिकता: आस्तिकता f. (-ता) Belief in God.  E. आस्तिक and तल् affix; also with त्व affix आस्तिकत्वं.
आस्तिकार्थद: आस्तिकार्थद m. (-दः) A name of a king, also called JANAMEJAYA. E. आस्तिक the Muni, अर्थ a request, and द who gives or grants; having at his request spared the Naga TAKSHAKA, from the destruction to which he had devoted the race.
आस्तीक: आस्तीक m. (-कः) The name of a Muni or saint, the son of JARATKĀRU, also a Muni: see आस्तिक.  E. अस्ति and ठक् aff.
आस्तीकजननी: आस्तीकजननी f. (-नी) The wife of JARATKĀRU, a saint.  E. आस्तीक as above, and जननी a mother, the mother of that saint.
आस्तीक्य: आस्तीक्य n. (-क्यं) Belief in Providence and a future world.  E. आस्तीक a believer, and यञ् aff.
आस्तीर्ण: आस्तीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Spread, strewed, scattered.  E. आङ् before स्तृ to spread, क्त aff.
आस्तृत: आस्तृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Spread. 	 2. Covered.  E. आङ् before स्तृ to spread, affix क्त.
आस्था: आस्था f. (-स्था) 	 1. Prop, stay, place or means of abiding. 	 2. An assembly. 3. Effort, pains, care. 	 4. Consideration, regard.  E. आङ् before स्था to stay, to stand, अङ् and टाप् affs.
आस्थान: आस्थान nf. (-नं-नी) An assembly. 	 n. (-नं) 	 1. Place, site. 	 2. Staying, abid-ing. 	 5. Pains, care.  E. आङ् before स्था to stay or stand, ल्युट् and ङीप् affs.
आस्थापन: आस्थापन n. (-नं) 	 1. Placing, fixing, causing to stay or remain. 	 2. An enema of oil, ghee, &c.  E. आङ् before स्था to stay, causal form. ल्युट् aff.
आस्थित: आस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Stayed, dwelt, abiding, abode. 	 2. Applied to, having recourse to. 	 3. Occupied, engrossed by, engaged in. 	 4. Spread, overspread. 	 5. Obtained. 	 6. Observing, adhering to, follow-ing, practising.  E. आङ् before स्था to stay, and क्त aff.
आस्पद: आस्पद n. (-दं) 	 1. Business, affair. 	 2. Office, rank, station. 	 3. Dignity. 	 4. Authority. 	 5. Place, site.  E. आङ् before पद् to go, deriv. irr.
आस्पदन: आस्पदन n. (-नं) Trembling, throbbing.  E. आङ् before स्पदि to shake, ल्युट् aff.
आस्पर्द्धा: आस्पर्द्धा f. (-र्द्धा) Emulation, rivalry.  E. आङ् before स्पर्द्ध to vie with, अच् and टाप् affs.
आस्पर्द्धिन्: आस्पर्द्धिन् mfn. (-र्द्धी-र्द्धिनी-र्द्धि) Emulous.  E. आस्पर्द्धा and इनि aff.
आस्फाल: आस्फाल m. (-लः) 	 1. Striking, rubbing, causing to move gently. 	 2. Flap-ping, clapping. 	 3. The flapping motion of an elephant's ear.  E. आङ् before स्फल to move, causal form, घञ् aff.
आस्फालन: आस्फालन n. (-नं) 	 1. Pride, arrogance. 	 2. Rubbing, stirring, moving gently.  E. आङ् before स्फल to move, causal form, affix ल्युट्.
आस्फालित: आस्फालित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Struck gently, rubbed, touched, stirred. 	 2. Flapped, clapped, struck together.  E. आङ् before स्फल to move, causal form, क्त aff.
आस्फुजित्: आस्फुजित् m. (-जित्) A name of a SUKRA, regent of the planet VENUS, and teacher of the Asuras.
आस्फोट: आस्फोट m. (-टः) 	 1. A plant, (Swallow wort.) 	 2. The sound of striking on the arms, as made by combatants, wrestlers, &c. 	 f. (-टा) A wild variety of jasmin.  E. आङ् before स्फुट to expand, and अच् affix; also आस्फोन and आस्फोता.
आस्फोटक: आस्फोटक m. (-कः) A tree, (Careya arborea.)  E. आङ् before स्फुट् to blow, &c. and वुन् aff.
आस्फोटन: आस्फोटन n. (-नं) 	 1. Blowing, expanding. 	 2. Contracting, closing. 	 3. Slapping the arms, or the noise made by it. 	 f. (-नी) A gimlet or auger.  E. आङ् before स्फुट् to blow or expand, and ल्युट् aff.
आस्फोत: आस्फोत m. (-तः) 	 1. Swallow wort, (Asclepias gigantea.) 	 2. Mountain ebony, (Bauhinia variegata, &c.) 	 3. A kind of echites or savanna flower, (E. dichotoma, Rox.) 	 f. (-ता) 	 1. A wild variety of jasmin. 	 2. Clitoria ternatea.  E. आङ् before स्फुट् to blow or expand, अच् affix and ट changed to त; or स्फै to encrease, with क्त affix, and आ con-verted to ओ; also sometimes आस्फोट and आस्फोटा.
आस्य: आस्य n. (-स्यं) 	 1. the face. 	 2. The mouth. 	 mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Belonging or relating to the mouth or face.  E. अस् to throw or direct, and ण्यत् affix, or आङ् before स्यन्द to go, and ड affix; to which food goes or is directed. 	 f. (-स्या) Stay, abiding, resting.  E. आस् to sit, and ण्यत् affix.
आस्यपत्र: आस्यपत्र n. (-त्रं) A lotus.  E. आस्य a face, पत्र a leaf; this flower is com-monly compared to a beautiful face.
आस्यलाङ्गल: आस्यलाङ्गल m. (-लः) A hog, a boar.  E. आस्य and लाङ्गल a plough; whose face is as it were a plough.
आस्यलोमन्: आस्यलोमन् n. (-म) The beard.  E. आस्य and लोमन् hair; the hair of the face.
आस्यासव: आस्यासव m. (-वः) Spittle, saliva.  E. अस्य the mouth, आसव liquor.
आस्रप: आस्रप m. (-पः) The nineteenth lunar mansion.  E. अस्रप a Rakshasa or goblin, and अण् aff. one of this race being the deity of the asterism.
आस्रव: आस्रव m. (-वः) 	 1. Distress, pain, affliction. 	 2. Flow, issue, running, dis charge.  E. आङ् before स्रु to go, and अच् aff.
आस्राव: आस्राव m. (-वः) 	 1. Pain, affliction. 	 2. Flow, issue, running, discharge. E. आङ् before स्रु to ooze, घञ् aff.
आस्वनित: आस्वनित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sounded.  E. आङ् before स्वन् to sound, क्त affix, with इट् augment.
आस्वान्त: आस्वान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Sounded.  E. आङ् before स्वन् to sound, क्त aff.
आस्वाद: आस्वाद m. (-दः) 	 1. Tasting, eating. 	 2. Enjoying. 	 3. Flavour.  E. आङ् be-fore ष्वद् to taste, affix घञ्.
आस्वादन: आस्वादन n. (-नं) 	 1. Tasting, eating. 	 2. Enjoying.  E. आङ् before ष्वद् to taste, ल्युट् aff.
आस्वादित: आस्वादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Tasted. 	 2. Enjoyed, possessed. 	 3. Eaten. E. आङ् before ष्वद् to taste, affix क्त.
आह: आह ind. An interjection, aha! ah! implying. 	 1. Casting, sending. 	 2. Severity, reproof. 	 3. Commanding.
आहक: आहक m. (-कः) A disease of the nose, inflammation of the Schneideri-an membrane.
आहत: आहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Struck, beaten. 	 2. Injured, killed. 	 3. Multiplied. 4. Known, understood. 	 5. Uttered falsely. 	 n. (-तं) 	 1. Old cloth or raiment. 	 2. New cloth or clothes. 	 3. Assertion of an impossibility. m. (-तः) A drum.  E. आङ्, before हन् to hurt or injure, affix क्त.
आहतलक्षण: आहतलक्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Noted for good qualities.  E. आहत known, and लक्षण a mark.
आहर: आहर m. (-रः) 	 1. Breath inspired, inspiration. 	 2. Taking, seizing. E. आङ् before हृ to take, अप् aff.
आहरण: आहरण n. (-णं) 	 1. Taking, seizing. 	 2. Causing, inducing. 	 3. Extracting, removing.  E. आङ् before हृ to take, affix ल्युट्.
आहर्तृ: आहर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) One who takes or seizes. 	 m. (-र्त्ता) (In law,) A copy-holder.  E. आङ् before हृ to take, तृच् aff.
आहर्त्तृ: आहर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) One who takes or seizes. 	 m. (-र्त्ता) (In law,) A copy-holder.  E. आङ् before हृ to take, तृच् aff.
आहव: आहव m. (-वः) 	 1. War, battle. 	 2. Sacrificing.  E. आङ् before हु to sacrifice or ह्वेञ् to call, and अच् aff.
आहवन: आहवन n. (-नं) Sacrifice, offering sacrifice  E. आङ् before हु to sacrifice, ल्युट् aff.
आहवनीय: आहवनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be offered as an oblation. 	 m. (-यः) A con-secrated fire taken from the house-holder's perpetual fire, and prepared for receiving oblations.  E. आङ् before हु to offer abla-tions, and अनीयर् aff.
आहवनीयक: आहवनीयक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Fit for a burnt offering. 	 m. (-कः) A con-secrated fire.  E. कन् added to the last.
आहार: आहार m. (-रः) 	 1. Food. 	 2. Taking, conveying.  E. आङ् before हृ to convey, घञ aff.
आहारसम्भव: आहारसम्भव m. (-वः) The juice of the body, chyle, lymph, serum, &c. E. आहार food, and सम्भव what is produced.
आहारार्थिन्: आहारार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) Begging or seeking for food.  E. आहार food and अर्थिन् who asks.
आहार्य: आहार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 	 1. Adventitious, accessory, incidental. 	 2. To be taken or seized. 	 3. To be eaten. 	 m. (-र्य्यः) The ornamentative part of the drama, the dress, decorations, &c.  E. आङ् before हृञ् to convey, ण्यत् aff.
आहार्य्य: आहार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 	 1. Adventitious, accessory, incidental. 	 2. To be taken or seized. 	 3. To be eaten. 	 m. (-र्य्यः) The ornamentative part of the drama, the dress, decorations, &c.  E. आङ् before हृञ् to convey, ण्यत् aff.
आहार्यशोभा: आहार्य्यशोभा f. (-भा) Adventitious beauty, beauty not natural but the effect of paint, ornaments, &c.  E. आहार्य्य incidental, and शोभा splendor.
आहार्य्यशोभा: आहार्य्यशोभा f. (-भा) Adventitious beauty, beauty not natural but the effect of paint, ornaments, &c.  E. आहार्य्य incidental, and शोभा splendor.
आहाव: आहाव m. (-वः) 	 1. A trough near a well for watering cattle. 	 2. War, battle. 	 3. Calling.  E. आङ् before ह्वे to call, घञ् affix, deriv. irr.
आहिक: आहिक m. (-कः) 	 1. A name of the inspired grammarian PANINI. 	 2. The descending node.  E. अहि a snake, or the constellation Aslesha, and ठक् aff.
आहिण्डिक: आहिण्डिक m. (-कः) A man of fixed origin, the son of a Nishada father and Vaidehi mother, employed as a watchman on the outside of jails, &c.
आहित: आहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Placed, deposited. 	 2. Entertained, felt. 	 3. Comprising, containing. 	 4. Made, done.  E. आङ् before धा to have or hold, part. affix क्त, form irr.
आहितलक्षण: आहितलक्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Noted for good qualities. E. See आहतलक्षण.
आहितव्यथ: आहितव्यथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Pained, grieved.  E. आहित felt, व्यथा pain.
आहितस्वन: आहितस्वन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Noisy, uttering or making sound.  E. आहित made, स्वन a sound.
आहिताङ्क: आहिताङ्क mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं) Marked, spotted, stained.  E. आहित made, अङ्क a spot.
आहिताग्नि: आहिताग्नि m. (-ग्निः) A Brahman who has preserved a sacred fire kept alive perpetually in a family, &c.  E. आहित placed, and अग्नि a fire; by whom.
आहितुण्डिक: आहितुण्डिक m. (-कः) A juggler, a snake-catcher.  E. अहि a snake, तुण्ड a mouth, and ठक् affix; playing with the mouth of a snake: the poisonous fangs being extracted, the snakes are suffered to bite their exhibitors.

आहूत: आहूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Called, summoned, invoked, invited.  E. आङ be-fore ह्वे to call, क्त aff.
आहूतप्रपलायिन्: आहूतप्रपलायिन् m. (-यी) A defendant or witness absconding, or not ap-pearing when summoned.  E. आहूत and प्रपलायिन् who runs away.
आहूति: आहूति f. (-तिः) Calling.  E. आङ् before ह्वे to call, affix क्तिन्; ए is dropped, and व is changed to its analogous vowel उ.
आहृत: आहृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Brought, taken, collected.  E. आङ् before हृ to take, क्त aff.
आहृत्य: आहृत्य ind. Having taken or received, having brought.  E. आङ् before हृ to take, ल्यप् aff.
आहेय: आहेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Belonging or relating to a snake.  E. अहि a snake, and ढञ् aff.
आहो: आहो ind. 	 1. An interjection of doubt; 2. Of asking.
आहोपुरुषिका: आहोपुरुषिका f. (-का) Boasting, military vaunting.  E. आहो, पुरुष a man, and affix कन्; doubting another's manhood, &c.
आहोस्वित्: आहोस्वित् ind. A particle implying doubt.  E. आहो and स्वित् aff.
आह्न: आह्न n. (-ह्नं) Many days.  E. अहन् a day, and अण् aff.
आह्निक: आह्निक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Daily, diurnal, of or belonging to a day. 	 n. (-कं) 	 1. Constant occupation, daily work. 	 2. The division or section of a book. 	 3. Food.  E. अहन् a day, and ठक् aff.
आह्निकाचार: आह्निकाचार m. (-रः) Daily observance, the prayers and practices neces-sary for bodily and mental purification.  E. आह्निक daily and आचार observance.
आह्लाद: आह्लाद m. (-दः) Joy, delight.  E. आङ् before ह्लद् to be pleased, affix घञ्.
आह्लादित: आह्लादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Delighted, rejoiced.  E. आङ् before ह्लद् to be delighted, क्त aff.
आह्व: आह्व m. (-ह्वः) A crier, who or what calls. 	 f. (-ह्वा) 	 1. A name, an ap-pellation. 	 2. A call, a summons.  E. आङ् before ह्वे to call, क aff.
आह्वय: आह्वय m. (-यः) 	 1. A name or appellation. 	 2. A lawsuit arising from a dispute about games with animals, as cock-fighting, &c.  E. आङ् before ह्वेञ् to call, अच् aff.
आह्वान: आह्वान n. (-नं) 	 1. Calling, a call or summons. 	 2. Legal summons. 	 3. A name, an appellation. 	 4. Invocation, invitation.  E. आङ् before ह्वेञ् to call, ल्युट् aff.
आह्वानदर्शन: आह्वानदर्शन n. (-नं) Day of trial.  E. आह्वान summons, and दर्शन seeing, investigating.
आह्वाय: आह्वाय m. (-यः) 	 1. A name. 	 2. A summons.  E. आङ्ह्वे to call, घ aff.
आह्वायक: आह्वायक m. (-कः) A messenger, a courier.  E. आङ्ह्वे to call, ण्वुल् aff.
